This effect will be strongest among employees who initially fear career consequences from disclosing mental health difficulties.

   **Reasoning.** Employees may perceive two distinct risks when considering workplace mental health resources.    Manager training can reduce the first concern by improving managers’ responses to distress, accommodation requests, and help-seeking. However, supportive behavior may not resolve uncertainty about what an employer-sponsored app records or shares.
